home.title: A passion for horses, excellence in riding.
home.sub: An equestrian club in Paamul, Riviera Maya. Lessons, boarding and show jumping, surrounded by nature.
home.familyText: At the club you grow up with horses: the little ones start at age 2 on ponies, riders progress at their own pace and some go on to compete. Parents, kids and instructors share the arena, the paddocks and the celebrations.

familyPoints.a: From age 2 all the way to competition
familyPoints.b: Instructors who know every rider and every horse
familyPoints.c: A quiet place, surrounded by jungle

home.therapyText: We're preparing therapeutic activities with horses for children, led by certified professionals. Add your name to the interest list.
home.appText: Club families handle everything in the app, no calls or notebooks.

appPoints.plan: See your plan and the lessons you have left

home.ctaText: Book a trial lesson and enjoy your first ride around the arena.

classes.title: Learn to ride, at your own pace.
classes.sub: Lessons for kids from age 2 and adults, beginner to advanced, in small groups by age and level.
classes.levelsLead: We suggest a group for your age and experience; you move up a level when your instructor says so.

ponies.title: Ponies
ponies.text: From age 2: first steps, confidence and play with the pony.

beginner.title: Beginner
beginner.text: Position, walk and trot, and caring for the horse before and after riding.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.text: Canter, control and first jumps, with more independence.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.text: Show jumping, fine technique and getting ready to compete.

classes.earlyText: For the little ones: activities on the ground and on the pony that support balance, coordination and confidence, always accompanied.
classes.ctaText: Message us on WhatsApp and we'll suggest a time.

pony.text: A morning for the little ones with the club's ponies: riding, brushing and getting to know them up close.

therapy.whatText: Therapeutic activities with horses for children, led by a certified equine therapist together with a health professional (physiotherapist or psychologist). The horse's movement and contact with the animal support the child's development.
